models.name: Demibu
models.description: Meet the Demibu – the original all-rounder by Phil Grace. Blending performance with flow, the Demibu is a go-to everyday board built for smooth transitions, fast rail-to-rail response, and total control across a wide range of conditions. A slightly fuller nose boosts paddle power, while its well-balanced outline and tuned rocker deliver speed and maneuverability in everything from playful beach breaks to punchier surf. The single-to-double concave bottom keeps you connected and quick through turns, offering a lively, responsive ride without sacrificing stability. Whether you're progressing your surfing or just need one board to do it all, the Demibu has your back. Available as a Thruster…

models.name: Nose Rider
models.description: The Nose Rider – built for elegance and timeless style. Refined on the long, peeling points of Torquay and the Basque Country, The Nose Rider is Phil Grace’s tribute to classic longboarding – where rail setting, clean pivots, and graceful walks to the tip define the ride. Designed for pure nose-riding performance, this model features a generous 19-inch nose and a deep spoon concave that locks in trim even on the smallest of windswells. From ankle-high peelers to waist-high perfection, it holds the line and lets you hang ten with ease and elegance. Available in three finely tuned sizes: 9'0" x 22 1/2" x 2 7/8" – 67.54L : A touch more responsive underfoot, ideal for tighter pockets and…

models.name: Silver Fox
models.description: Silver Fox – speed, soul, and single fin magic. An evolution of the legendary Silver Fox , The Purple Haze by Phil Grace is a love letter to an era when surfing was about style, not spray. Inspired by the days of hard rails, deep Vs, and pure trim, this board blends vintage soul with modern performance. It’s all about effortless glide and smooth clean arcs – no pumping, no frantic arms – just you, one fin, and a board that wants to fly. With Gracey’s signature rolled V and rail work, the Purple Haze hums with speed and flow straight from the take-off. For surfers who crave simplicity, rhythm, and stoke in every turn, The Purple Haze is the trip you've been waiting for. One fin. Endless…

models.description: A true throwback with a twist, The Grace Single Fin captures the essence of pure surfing. With the wide point pushed forward, it channels the timeless lines of the original single fin era – but this isn’t just a relic. Phil Grace has brought it into the now, adding a subtle double concave for speed and smooth, effortless turns. Finished with Gracey’s signature fin, this board is built for those who ride with style and purpose. Old soul. New spark. All style. Standard dimensions available. Custom shapes available on request – contact us to make it your own. Sprays, Tints, Pigments, Pinlines, Wet Rub & Polish, Custom Stringers P.O.A 5'10" x 19" x 2 3/8" 27.22 L 6'0" x 19 1/4" x 2 3/8" 28.79…

models.name: The Glider
models.description: The Glider – built for distance, designed for soul. Effortless trim, endless glide – The Glider is Phil Grace’s ode to graceful lines and long journeys. A true paddle machine, it’s made to cruise across small conditions but holds its own up to head-high surf with poise and flow. With Gracey’s signature rolled V bottom and soft, downturned rails, The Glider is all about harnessing momentum and letting the board do the work. Designed for knee paddling, trimming, and long, unbroken lines, this board invites you to slow down and cover serious ground – or ocean. Ride it as a classic single fin or with 1+2 sidebites for added control. Starting at 9’0” and stretching up to a majestic 12’0”, The…

models.name: The Heritage
models.description: The Heritage – a timeless nod to longboarding’s golden era. Crafted as a tribute to the roots of classic surf culture, The Heritage channels pure tradition with every glide. Its retro-style hip pulls the wide tail back, echoing the elegant lines and smooth flow of original longboard design. With a rolled V bottom and soft, downturned rails, this single-fin beauty is built for soulful trimming, graceful footwork, and laid-back style. Choose between a rounded square or pintail to suit your preferred line — either way, The Heritage invites you to slow it down and savour every ride. Standard dimensions available. Sprays, Tints, Pigments, Pinlines, Wet Rub & Polish, Custom Stringers P.O.A 8'0"…

We have put dual concaves from in front of the fins to loosen the tail making it a very versatile board. The board has a very high polish finish which is very labour intensive. Makes this board a board to consider. Great buying at this price Shaped and designed by Ron..

models.name: Blackfeather
models.description: Size: 5'8" x 19 1/4" x 2 7/16" {28 Litres} Our Black Feather model is available as a Thruster whilst the 5 fin configuration can also be used as a Quad. Slight concaves running from just in front of the fins helps loosen the tail and acceleration out of a turn. This board is suitable for small to medium size waves. Fins included.

models.description: Size: 9’2″ x 22.5″ x 2 7/8″ Australian made Longboard with dual 12mm cedar stringers. 3 stage bottom. Concave under nose, dual concaves in the tail section. This shape board is available as single or with sides. High polished finish very labour intensive. Shaped and designed by Ron.

models.name: F1-11 Twin
models.description: Size: 6’8” x 21 ½” x 2 3/4” Sky blue deck and Mid blue bottom, with dual pin lines around the deck. Highly polished, very labour intensive. A great board for surfing waves between 3ft to around 6 ft Shaped and designed by Ron.

brands.name: Shortie Surfboards
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped East Coast Australian shortboards and mid-lengths from Sam Ayton — 717, Crazy Swayze, Twinkle Toes 2.0, Micro Mid, and HP Camel.

models.description: The 717 Model is a very versatile step-up for waves between 4-8 feet.    It has foam pushed forward for ease of paddling and a lower rail for extra bite in the tube.  It has a continuous rocker with a tad extra nose lift to accomodate for those steeper waves and to help avoid nose-diving.   With a single to double concave, this board also performs really well on the open face.  I recommend riding this 4” longer than your normal shortboard and about an 1/8” narrower.   The quad setup feels amazing in this board!  However, it can be ridden as a quad or a thruster.

models.name: Crazy Swayze
models.description: The Crazy Swayze is your ideal board for all conditions.  It has a low entry/exit rocker and a deep single concave to create lift and speed.  Combined with a double concave out the tail for maximum manoeuvrability, it makes it feel as if the board is doing all the work for you.  The outline is pushed slightly forward of centre for ease of paddling.  The rails are straightened off the tail to create some serious drive through turns.  I recommend riding this board about an inch longer than your own height.

models.name: HP Camel
models.description: This is your high performance work horse.  Though it may appear to have a similar outline to the crazy Swayze, it has a little extra rocker in the nose and a late flow in the tail.  With a lower rail and a single to double concave, this board transitions from rail to rail with ease.   I’d recommend riding this board the same size as your standard Shortie shortboard!

models.name: Micro Mid
models.description: The micro mid is the ultimate fun board, taking the shape of a mid-length, but subtracting the length while still holding plenty of volume.    ‍The wide point on this is pushed 2 1/2” North of the centre, making the nose nice and wide while the tail is pulled into a pin.  It surfs like a shortboard, but paddles as if it had 100 litres.   To add to this, it has a vee bottom running from the nose to tail and double concave out the back, so turning is made easy!  I recommend riding this board about 3”-5” longer than your short board.    It can be ridden as a straight twin fin or has the option for a stabiliser fin.

models.name: Twinkle Toes 2.0
models.description: The Twinkle Toes 2.0 is my modern spin on the retro twin fin, with extreme fun in mind.  This board has become even more refined than the original version.  It has a vee in the nose and under the chest to make paddling a breeze.  Then, it flows from a single concave into a double, that ultimately vees out of the swallow tail.    This board can be ridden as a straight twin or with a stabiliser fin.   I recommend riding this board the same length as you are tall.

brands.name: A Mano
brands.location_label: Ewingsdale, Byron Bay, New South Wales, Australia
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped twin pins, fishes, eggs, and single fins from Simon's Byron Hinterland bay — every A Mano board is shaped start to finish in-house.

models.name: Classic Single
models.description: Our Classic Single Fin is designed for bigger waves hitting long point breaks; think long carving lines on big faces. This surfboard is handshaped in Byron Bay

models.name: Egg
models.description: Our most versatile and user friendly mid length, the Egg is the Cadillac of surfboards. The single fin Egg is the board you can surf every day of the year. 100% hand shaped in the Byron Bay Hinterland

models.name: Fish
models.description: Our take on the traditional twin fin fish, this board has loads of foam squeezed in for excellent paddle power, featuring a beak nose combined with low refined rails. This surfboard is handshaped in Byron Bay

models.name: Long Fish
models.description: The Long Fish is our most dynamic and exciting mid length. Low refined rails combine with the twin fin set up to maintain sensitivity in a bigger board. This surfboard is 100% hand shaped in Byron Bay

models.name: Mini Simmons
models.description: The Mini Simons quad has all the speed you need to liven up small wave sessions, this board is a nod to one of surfing's great pioneers Bob Simmons.  100% hand shaped in the Byron Bay Hinterland

models.name: Stage Two Twin Pin
models.description: The next generation of our Twin Pin, this trimmed down and performance orientated Twin Fin is a fast and reactive everyday shortboard that won’t let you down. This surfboard is hand shaped in Byron Bay

models.name: Step Up Twin Pin
models.description: The next generation of our Twin Pin, this trimmed down and performance orientated Twin Fin is a fast and reactive everyday shortboard that won’t let you down. This surfboard is hand shaped in Byron Bay

models.name: Twin Pin
models.description: Our Twin Pin stretches out a classic twin fin surfboard template to emphasise speed, excitement and reliability. 100% handshaped in our Byron Bay workshop

brands.name: POG Surfboards
brands.short_description: Custom and off-the-rack boards from Paul O'Grady on the Sunshine Coast since 1981 — Flying Fish, Sick Squid, No Brainer, and classic mals.

models.name: Cuttle Fish
models.description: The Cuttle Fish is a classic egg plan shape and a great all-rounder. Extremely versatile, it can be set up as a single, quad/thruster or even a twin. The simple plan shape is enhanced by a forward chined concave to double concave bottom.

models.name: Flying Fish
models.description: A throwback to the late 70s and 80s with its distinctive semi-retro single-flyer swallowtail plan shape. With a little extra width and thickness, the Flying Fish will improve your wave count even on the smaller days. Designed with a single to double concave and a pulled-in tail, the Flying Fish thruster delivers powerful, top-to-bottom performance even on bigger days.

models.name: Flying Fish Single
models.description: Single flyer swallow tail with a pulled in nose and narrower tail — the Flying Fish as a dedicated single fin for longer lines and a more classic feel.

models.name: Flying Fish Twin
models.description: A single flyer swallow tail twin fin throw-back to the late 70s and early 80s with heavy influences of Mark Richards and Larry Bertlemann. The plan shape of the Twin version has been tweaked to produce a shorter tail behind the fins to deliver drive while maintaining the looseness and speed of the Twin.

models.name: Fryed Fish
models.description: A modernised Steve Lis or Skip Frye twin keel fish with a wide deep swallow tail. A full nose with extra volume and width and low rocker allows the Fryed Fish to catch waves like a Malibu and surf like a skateboard.

models.name: Mal
models.description: Whether you prefer old-style logs with pinched rails or modern mals with noseriding rockers and concaves for manoeuvrability, POG custom mals are designed with the features you want on a classic longboard.

models.name: No Brainer
models.description: A post-apocalyptic modern shortboard for those who just want to shred in and above the lip. The No Brainer is a high-performance comp-light model for advanced surfers in all kinds of waves. Speed is maximised by a single concave running from the front foot to the back fin, usually set up with a thruster/quad option.

models.name: Sick Squid
models.description: Another all-rounder with a fuller nose and outline than the Flying Fish, this one lends itself to the single board quiver as well. Extra girth for paddle power in fatter conditions, with the versatility of a quad/thruster setup across a very broad range of surf.

models.name: Soul Fish
models.description: The Soul Fish is not really a fish at all but a modernised single fin for the retro purist. Pulled-in nose and reduced tail area produce longer cleaner lines, complimented by a pin, rounded pin, or small swallow. A go-to for reef and solid point breaks.

models.name: Sprat
models.description: The Sprat is a single flyer swallow tail twinzer with a wider tail and a wide round nose. This board has a concave chined hull forward into a double concave through the fins.
